service.name: Singer and guitarist
service.serviceType: Acoustic singer and guitarist for cocktail hours, welcome drinks, patios, dinner parties and small weddings
service.description: One voice and a guitar, playing singer-songwriter, pop, soul and classic rock covers at a volume guests talk across, for cocktail hours, welcome drinks, patios, dinner parties, rehearsal dinners and small weddings across Denver, the Front Range and the Colorado mountain corridor, with sound included.

faqs.q: Is one singer with a guitar enough for a cocktail hour?
faqs.a: For most cocktail hours and patios, yes. One voice and a guitar sound like live music from across a terrace and stay under the conversation. Above about a hundred guests spread across a ballroom, the acoustic duo adds a second musician to fill the space.

About the level of two guests talking who have just met. People at the next table can hear the words and keep talking at their own level. One musician sets the level to the space, and a voice and a guitar stay there all night.

faqs.q: Can a singer and guitarist play a wedding ceremony and the cocktail hour?
faqs.a: Yes, and it's a common booking: an instrumental prelude and processional, then the same musician sings the cocktail hour on the terrace. The small sound system runs the officiant's microphone too, so the ceremony and the hour are one setup and one contract.
Sets run 45 to 60 minutes with music through the breaks, for a single hour or from arrival through dinner. If the night runs long, another half hour is easy to add on the night.

faqs.q: How is this different from the solo guitarist?
faqs.a: The voice. The solo guitarist is instrumental: jazz standards and Spanish-tinged sets that sit under a dinner. The singer and guitarist sings the songs out front, for the hours where guests want to hear a voice and know the words.

Yes, and patios and lawns are its regular work. It needs a covered, level and dry spot with power run to it, and we agree a plan for moving indoors with you ahead of time, because Colorado evenings cool fast and a guitar and a voice both slow down in the cold.
